Name: Shade's Shane Portraits
Author: Koderjojo
Description:
Just a portrait mod for Shane I drew myself. I did my best to keep the quality of the originally images I drew when I shrunk them down.

Installation-
Put the Shane.xnb file into the Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits folder, and replace the already existing file in there.
Don't forget to keep a backup of the original if you wish to revert back.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
